input.summary: Extend Deliverable conformance warranty from 15 to 90 days and remove the cut-off of correction/refund obligations
input.comment: [Playbook] We have extended the Deliverable conformance warranty from fifteen days to ninety (90) days and removed the sentence cutting off Vendor's correction and refund obligations, since a 15-day period falls below our minimum warranty duration and effectively expires with the acceptance testing window in Section 6.1. The Section 19.4 repair/replace/refund remedy continues to apply.

ops.oldText: For fifteen days after delivery, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation; after that date Vendor has no correction or refund obligation.
ops.newText: For ninety (90) days after delivery, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation. Customer's remedy for breach of this warranty is set out in Section 19.4.
